footnotes.text: Jesus Christ instituted the sacrament among His disciples in Jerusalem during the annual Passover celebration, which includes a symbolic meal with bread to remember that God delivered the Israelites from Egypt (seeMark 14:12; see alsoExodus 12:17). President Jeffrey R. Holland, Acting President of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles, asked, “Do we see [our weekly sacrament service] asourpassover, remembrance ofoursafety and deliverance and redemption? … It should be a powerful, reverent, reflective moment” (“This Do in Remembrance of Me,”Ensign, Nov. 1995, 68).
General Handbook: Serving in The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints, 29.2.1, Gospel Library.
